rules.sentence: SS18:SSX1 and SS18:SSX2 (and rarely SS18:SSX4) are the fusion proteins expressed in 95% of patients diagnosed with SS and are essential in establishing the diagnosis.
More than 90% of synovial sarcoma have a focal expression of cytoplasmic cytokeratins (CK) and membranous expression of EMA (epithelial membrane antigen).
Although many keratins can be expressed in SS (AE1/AE3, CAM 5.2), CK-7 and CK-19 are restricted to patients with SS and help establish the diagnosis.
